title: Django Inference Path and Missing Assets
description: Begins with a plain-language explanation of views, predictor, routes, stub tests, and absent production model, then traces the corresponding implementation and its limits in plant-leaf-disease-detection-cnn.
learning_objectives: Explain views, predictor, routes, stub tests, and absent production model in plain language and connect it to home/views.py; home/urls.py; home/predictor.py.
Trace one input through the django inference path and missing assets stage and identify its output and assumptions.
Diagnose one failure mode or limitation before extending this stage.
prerequisites: Read project prerequisites and the previous module when present.
concepts_covered: views, predictor, routes, stub tests, and absent production model
practical_outcomes: Trace the django inference path and missing assets stage through the cited source paths.
Produce a small test or diagnostic for views, predictor, routes, stub tests, and absent production model.
completion_criteria: Complete the three lessons and exercise.
Answer all ten module questions using material from these lessons.
Submit a short source citation and limitation note.
